title: International Patient Summary — knowledge-graph example (Swedish-oriented)
description: Official openEHR International Patient Summary template (CKM 1013.26.376) with its archetypes, selected nodes, terminology concepts, and two fictitious IPS composition instances. Preferred ontologies are those available on the Nordic Ontoserver: SNOMED CT Swedish edition, NPU (lab results), WHO ICD-10 (ICD-10-SE is not on the server), and ATC (listed but not resolvable; Swedish names from FASS). KVÅ is listed only as an empty stub and is not used. LOINC is omitted.

terminology_server.request_style: TermViz (src/snomed.js, default branch master): ONTOSERVER=https://tx-nordics.fhir.org/fhir/r4, SNOMED_SYSTEM=http://snomed.info/sct, GET CodeSystem/$lookup?system&code&property=parent&property=inactive&_format=json, Accept: application/fhir+json. ValueSet/$expand with url=http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs=ecl/<!{code} or ecl/{code} plus includeDesignations. No auth.

operations_tested.CodeSystem_lookup: works (SNOMED including expressions, NPU, ICD-10); ATC and UCUM fail
operations_tested.ValueSet_expand: works for SNOMED ECL implicit valuesets
operations_tested.CodeSystem_validate-code: broken: GET and POST return 400 'A code/system pair must be provided'

problems: The official complete IPS template (CKM 1013.26.376, 2020 DRAFT) is an early unmanaged draft of FHIR IPS IG v1.0.0; later incubator templates exist for Problem List and Allergies only.

openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.imaging_exam_result.v0 and openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.limitation_of_treatment.v0 could not be fetched via the CKM connector; ADLs came from the TermViz IPS fileset (verified-by-fileset). imaging_exam_result is now published as v1 (CID 1013.1.1494).
ICD-10-SE is not on the Nordic Ontoserver. Diagnosis codes use WHO ICD-10 (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10, 2019-covid-expanded).
KVÅ is listed only as an empty stub CodeSystem (http://piirainformatics.se/uri/, count=0, status draft) and was not used. Procedure instances are coded with SNOMED CT only.
ATC is listed on the Ontoserver with content=not-present and does not resolve for $lookup or implicit ValueSet $expand. Swedish ATC names were taken from FASS Vård ATC-register on 2026-11-10.
UCUM is listed but not resolvable by $lookup. Unit codes are conventional UCUM strings marked listed-not-resolvable.

CodeSystem/$validate-code (GET and POST) returns HTTP 400 'A code/system pair must be provided' on this server. Code checks used CodeSystem/$lookup and, for NPU, ValueSet/$validate-code POST against NPUFull (NPU02319 result=true).
No SNOMED↔ATC (or SNOMED↔ICD-10, SNOMED↔NPU) ConceptMap was found on the server. Cross-ontology pairing is only at the instance layer via coded_as, not as asserted maps.

The IPS template does not fix ICD value sets (problem_diagnosis at0002 is DV_TEXT). Fictitious instances therefore pair SNOMED CT with WHO ICD-10 codes verified on the Nordic Ontoserver (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10, 2019-covid-expanded); ICD-10-SE is not on the server. Eva: S52.5, I10, Z88.0; Lars: E11.9, I10 (shared), Z91.0.
CLUSTER.anatomical_location.v1 is slotted by problem_diagnosis at0039 but is not filled in the 2020 IPS OET; it is included so the Fig 5b laterality example can be instantiated.

Blood-pressure OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2 at0000 uses the official CKM term binding 364090009 (systemiskt artärtryck), verified from ADL/OET term_bindings — not Fig 5b 75367002 (blodtryck). 75367002 remains only as a verified SNOMED is-a parent of the systolic/diastolic observables.
431314004 Swedish display is 'perifer syremättnad' (Peripheral oxygen saturation), not the older 'Peripheral pulse oximetry' label.
LOINC is omitted from the graph because it is little used in Sweden. A few archetypes still carry official LOINC term bindings in their ADL; those leftover bindings are noted in the README only.
The two composition instances (Eva Holmgren, Lars Nyström) are clearly fictitious demo data with synthetic IDs, not Swedish personnummer.

TermViz currently loads an OPT, the IPS ADL fileset and a Snap2SNOMED CSV via publicUrl(); it does not yet load this template-kg-example/v1 JSON. The format is designed so a loader could fetch examples/manifest.json and then each example file the same way.
